cell_statement: Let n = T_k. Prove that every partition of n reaches delta_k = (k,k-1,...,1) under iterated B and that delta_k is the only cyclic partition. Then for n = T_{k-1} + r, 1 <= r <= k, determine all cyclic partitions of n and the number of distinct cycles of B on partitions of n, with proofs.

rules.additional_rules: OFFICIAL hand-in rules of this column (verbatim from the problem statement): For each cell you attempt, hand in a written proof. You may use a computer to explore. A proof may rely on a computation only if you include the code, it runs in under 10 minutes on a laptop, and the computation is exhaustive over a finite set that your argument has reduced the problem to. Where a cell asks you to determine a quantity, give the exact value as a formula in $k$ and prove both bounds; state any partitions you use explicitly as functions of $k$. Say clearly which cells you consider solved and which are partial.
